caseName: Kellogg Brown & Root Servs., Inc. v. United States ex rel. Carter
caseNameFull: KELLOGG BROWN & ROOT SERVICES, INC. v. UNITED STATES, ex rel. Benjamin CARTER.

opinions.text: Motion of Chamber of Commerce of the United States of America, et al. for leave to file a brief as amici curiae granted. Motion of National Defense Industrial Association for leave to file a brief as amicus curiae granted. Petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Fourth Circuit granted.
